summary: Stream the affected checkpoint operation index and retain only digest extrema

replay.detail: No replay. expected_operation keeps stored claim decoding and reads checkpoint digest extrema for its selected operation instead of copying/sorting its entire dropped-candidate vector.

schema.detail: Adds checkpoint_claims_operation_digest, a partial covering index on operation_id, request_digest and id, at ordinary Store open. Schema version remains17; existing checkpoint data is unchanged. First upgraded open builds the index over existing checkpoint metadata; time and writer cost are unmeasured.

rules.detail: Unchanged canonical stored ID/fallback, conflict decision, repaired and duplicate membership, snapshot and corruption refusal. No checkpoint/rules digest change.

compatibility.detail: No wire or API signature change. Existing old/new dependency collection, repair savepoints, outer transaction, failure rollback, runtime authority and commit-before-ACK remain in place.

downtime.detail: Normal restart plus first-open additive index construction; construction duration/writer cost is unmeasured. Selected checkpoint history is still decoded for legacy corruption refusal; complete heal repair-list and stored affected-operation history remain unbounded. No production latency acceptance.

manual.detail: No live heal, replay, reset, policy action or manual database operation is requested. Unrelated damaged operation rows are not silently rebuilt by a record repair.

recovery.detail: Older builds ignore the extra additive index and continue their original checkpoint enumeration. No immutable record/data rewrite or format migration.
